Phase 2 unique (site_id, event_id) and required event_id were not changed. 429 body has no site_id/limit/IP. Warnings: IPv6 snapshot uses 2a06:98c0::/32 vs live /29 (fail-closed, not a spoof hole); _background_aggregate and _bootstrap_one_site lack SET LOCAL 0; sweep SET LOCAL 0 dies at aggregator’s mid-function COMMIT before revive/company-resolve; ceiling hit() counts batches not events; stale Event.is_flagged_abuse comment still says site-ceiling is flag-but-store.
nonBlockingFindings: CF IPv6 snapshot stale: bundled 2a06:98c0::/32 vs published 2a06:98c0::/29 (cloudflare.com/ips-v6). IPv4 list matches. IPv6 is not empty. Fail-closed: edges in the expanded /29 minus /32 will ignore CF-Connecting-IP (identity collapse to edge IP), not honour a spoof.
peer_is_cloudflare does not unwrap IPv4-mapped IPv6 (::ffff:172.64.0.1). Dual-stack peers can fail the CF check and ignore a real CF-Connecting-IP.

F5 coverage is sweep + retention only. _background_aggregate and _bootstrap_one_site do not SET LOCAL 0. Safe if operator follows runbook (timeout only after Phase 1 incremental soak). Footgun if DB_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 while incremental is still OFF or during F9 bootstrap.

aggregate_visitors_for_site COMMITs at line 529. Sweep SET LOCAL 0 dies there. The heavy full-recompute SELECT is still covered. Post-commit revive + _resolve_companies inherit engine 30s. Retention correctly re-applies SET LOCAL at the start of each loop after COMMIT.

site_ceiling_tripped uses RateLimitItemPerMinute.hit once per ingest request, not per event. 155 is calibrated from events/min p99. A large batch (bounded by 256KB) consumes one token. Disk protection is looser than the events/min label.
apps/api/models/event.py is_flagged_abuse comment still says 'P3 site-ceiling trip OR P4 velocity' and 'Flag-but-store'. Ceiling no longer reaches INSERT. Comment-only drift; runtime path is correct.

Agent-classified ingest persists agent_visits / agent_fetch_events and returns 204 before the site ceiling. Events table is still protected. Out of Validation S1 wording (events) but a residual write under flood-shaped agent UAs.
Execute-agent pytest 45 passed was not independently re-run by this review. Static + test-source review only.

explicitQuestions.q2_set_local_after_commit: YES for retention — apply_long_job_statement_timeout after db.commit() is the next execute(); SQLAlchemy autobegins a new transaction, so SET LOCAL is in-transaction. Sweep does not re-apply after aggregator commit (see nonBlockingFindings).
explicitQuestions.q3_cf_cidr_stale_empty_ipv6: IPv6 not empty (7 ranges). IPv4 exact match to ips-v4. IPv6 slightly stale: 2a06:98c0::/32 vs live /29. Fail-closed, not a spoof bypass.

explicitQuestions.q5_pii_in_429_body: NO — detail is 'Too many requests. Please retry later.' Tests forbid site_id, '155', and 'limit' in the body. Warning log has site_id (internal, not the HTTP body).
